rationale: Monotonic non-increasing Volt-VAR curve with breakpoints at the feeder operating voltages. At the low-voltage step (base 0.94 pu) it injects reactive power (q_fraction=+0.19) to raise voltage above 0.95 pu; at nominal (1.00 pu) it is neutral (q=0); at the high-voltage step (1.07 pu) it absorbs reactive power (q_fraction=-0.38) to pull voltage below 1.05 pu. Reactive commands (Q=q_fraction*inverter_kVA) stay well inside the inverter capability sqrt(kVA^2-kW^2) at every step, and the corrected voltages remain within the [0.95, 1.05] pu band. The breakpoint values were chosen so the correction is also feasible if the command is scaled by available reactive capability, minimizing control effort while keeping voltage margins.
